about: The models scripts/model-eval.ts tries, besides the rule parser. A starter list: choosing the candidates is a separate research task. Keys go in the repo-root .env under keyEnv (git ignores it). Prices are US dollars per million tokens and stay null until filled in from each provider's current price page; the eval then prints the cost of 1,000 messages. Model ids were read from each provider's own docs on 3 Nov 2026 and have not been tried with a key: if every message of a candidate fails with an HTTP error, check the id and extraBody against the provider's docs.

candidates.name: claude-haiku-5-5
candidates.note: Anthropic's current fast, low-cost model (the id is from the Claude API model list). Effort low because reading one short message needs no long thinking. Price: fill from the provider's current price page.

candidates.name: gemini-3.5-flash-lite
candidates.note: Google's cheapest stable Gemini tier on the models page; reached through Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (key sent as a Bearer token). Free-tier keys are rate limited: add "pauseMs": 4000 if messages fail with HTTP 429. If every message gets HTTP 400, try "responseFormat": "json_object": whether its compatibility layer accepts a closed strict schema is the least certain part. Price: fill from the provider's current price page.

candidates.name: sarvam-105b-conversations
candidates.note: An Indian-language model, the variant meant for real-time conversation (the other is sarvam-105b). Its docs list both Authorization: Bearer and api-subscription-key and are not consistent: if every message gets HTTP 401 or 403, set "authHeader": "api-subscription-key". Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens. Price: fill from the provider's current price page.

candidates.name: groq-gpt-oss-20b
candidates.note: The cheapest production model on Groq's models page with published prices, and one of the models Groq lists for strict JSON-schema output. An open-weight model that may be weaker in Malayalam and Kannada: the eval is how to tell. Price: fill from the provider's current price page.

candidates.name: openai-gpt-6-luna
candidates.note: The model OpenAI's models page describes as the most efficient for focused, high-volume tasks. Its request shape was not tried: newer OpenAI models take max_completion_tokens and refuse a set temperature, so extraBody nulls those two. Price: fill from the provider's current price page.
